research_question: On new PUB T13 cases and the same local base model, does the strict pragmatic decomposition improve deictic reference resolution over strict generic deliberation by a practically meaningful amount?

hypothesis_provenance.development_signal: M14 T13 Ours 75.0% versus Generic 37.5%, with 8 candidate wins, 2 baseline wins, and 6 ties on 16 cases.
hypothesis_provenance.role: M14 generated the focused hypothesis and supplies the discordance planning parameter. M15 uses no M13/M14 formal case IDs and is the prospective confirmation set, not another exploratory re-interpretation.

sampling.stopping_rule: exactly 300 cases; no optional stopping, post-result extension, case replacement, or exclusion

power_analysis.test: exact unconditional power for candidate-direction rejection by two-sided exact McNemar
power_analysis.SESOI_rationale: A 15-point paired accuracy gain means at least one additional correct reference resolution per roughly seven cases; a smaller gain would not justify the extra specialized loop for this milestone claim.

contract_probe.reason: already viewed and excluded from every formal sample

metrics.primary: paired exact-answer accuracy Ours minus Generic
metrics.confirmatory_inference: 20,000 item-paired bootstrap 95% CI and exact two-sided McNemar
metrics.fidelity: exact required keys, types, uncertainty enum, and no additional properties

claim_if_passed: For qwen3.5:9b under this frozen strict-schema protocol, the explicit pragmatic decomposition improves exact deictic-reference resolution over equally strict generic deliberation by at least the preregistered 15-point SESOI on 300 new PUB T13 cases.
claim_if_failed: This prospective confirmation does not establish a practically meaningful deictic-reference advantage; retain the result and do not extend the sample or change the gate.
evidence_boundary: M15 is a focused post-development confirmation on disjoint public PUB T13 items. It compares one model and one deterministic option permutation, may be exposed through base-model pretraining, and tests exact multiple-choice deictic reference resolution rather than longitudinal human understanding, felt understanding, human preference, Uruha persona fidelity, or a human-brain equation.
